title: Receipts/DuplicateKeySilentlyDroppedTests.cs: edge-case test passes on head (1 tests): no defect shown; refutes 1 lens claim(s): logic-edge-1

refutes.claim: The new `ContainsKey` guards silently drop any member whose `[Key]` value duplicates an earlier member's key, and no diagnostic is reported. Example: a public `[MessagePackObject]` class with `[Key(0)] int FirstValue` and `[Key(0)] int SecondValue`. On base this threw on `Dictionary.Add`: the generator failed visibly (CS8785) and the analyzer failed (AD0001). On head the generator emits a formatter that never reads or writes `SecondValue`, which is silent data loss, and the analyzer reports nothing. With SuppressSourceGeneration=true, the analyzer also stays silent even though DynamicObjectResolver rejects duplicate keys at runtime. The same applies to duplicate string keys (`stringMembers`) and to the second copy of the loop at lines 1173/1189. This also changes behaviour when SuppressSourceGeneration is unset, contrary to the acceptance criteria.
